def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row}
    marker = next((v for v in colors if sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) > 1 and v not in (0,)), None)
    # The marker is the sparse color, while the repeated object is the other
    # non-background color; background is the most frequent color.
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    marks = [v for v in colors if v != bg and counts[v] < 100]
    marker = max(marks, key=lambda v: counts[v])
    objcolors = [v for v in colors if v not in (bg, marker)]
    obj = objcolors[0]
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == obj]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells}
    ar=(r1-r0)//2; ac=(c1-c0)//2
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == marker:
                for dr,dc in shape:
                    rr=r+dr-ar; cc=c+dc-ac
                    if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=obj
    return out
